messages:
matt: quick summary — ran multi-device attention sweep (A100 / H100 / L40S) comparing Flash variants, fused kernels, and our new paged-tiling path. seq sweep=128,512,1024,2048; batch sweep=1,4,16,64.

matt: bench command I used: `./tools/attn_bench --devices a100,h100,l40s --variants flash,flash-paged,fused,paged-tiling --seqs 128,512,1024,2048 --batches 1,4,16,64 --kvspill-threshold 0.75 --prefetch-window 4`

matt: high level: flash wins at low seq and small batch on A100/H100. paged-tiling overtakes at seq>=1024 for batch>=4 due to reduced memory amplification. fused shows strong perf at mid seq on H100 but regresses on L40S at batch 16+.

matt: pasted a tiny summary (p50 latency ms, per-device):
A100-flash: seq128 b1=6.2, b4=5.8, b16=7.1
A100-paged-tiling: seq1024 b4=12.3, b16=9.9 
H100-fused: seq512 b4=4.5, seq1024 b16=6.8
L40S-fused: seq1024 b16=22.4 (regression), paged-tiling seq1024 b16=11.7

matt: KV-cache behavior: when kv-cache hit ratio drops (simulated by varied prefix lengths), we see KV spill/start-of-iteration copies spike on L40S causing ~2.5-3x tail latency for fused kernels. paged path avoids full kv materialization so tail stays stable.

cheng: nice run — do you have profiler traces for the L40S fused regression? want to check memory copies vs kernel time.

matt: uploaded perf snippets below (raw lines):
```
L40S fused seq1024 b16: kernel_ms=9.2 memcpy_host=8.1 memcpy_device=4.7 catched_spill=1.8
L40S paged-tiling seq1024 b16: kernel_ms=7.0 memcpy_host=1.2 memcpy_device=0.4 catched_spill=0.1
```

anya: from the traces it looks like fused triggers extra workspace allocation path on L40S driver 510. I remember a similar allocation stall we patched earlier on H100 but driver differences may expose it here.

rachel: flagged this as a perf-regression for the L40S lane. can we bisect to the last known-good? if it’s driver-related we should fallback to paged by policy for L40S in the short term. :warning:

samir: I can run a focused bisect on the fused rollout — will run commit range `c1a2..c1b8` tomorrow and post microbench results.

cheng: also should test changing `--prefetch-window` from 4 -> 2, because prefetching more increased memory pressure and pushed fused into fallback path on L40S. smaller window lowered memcpy times in a quick try.

matt: good call. i did a quick run: prefetch=2 reduced memcpy_host from 8.1 -> 3.5 and overall tail down ~30%. but throughput at batch64 suffers a bit. tradeoff documented.

anya: action items: (1) samir to bisect fused regression on L40S (2) matt to add a runtime policy: on L40S, if batch>=16 and seq>=1024 prefer paged-tiling (temporary) (3) cheng to attach full perf traces and flamegraphs to the ticket.

rachel: filing ticket INF-7291, assigning to samir/matt. include links to the raw bench logs and the small trace snippet above.

infra-bot: deploy-check: nightly multi-device bench job scheduled for 06:00 UTC to validate prefetch-window=2 impact across regions.

samir: ack — starting bisect tomorrow morning and will report results here. :thumbsup:
